compositionBlocker: The public mainnet simulation runtime rejected every manually serialized transaction-v1 message as invalid message version. A 64-inline-account v1 wire was also rejected under the active 1232-byte raw transaction limit. Therefore the requested 4096-byte v1 KLend-to-Save atomic composition could not reach either program on this runtime; it was not replaced with a claimed v1 result.
